app.title: DEMATEL Analysis AI System
app.subtitle: Upload expert direct-influence matrices (CSV) to compute the total-relation matrix, prominence and relation indicators, and the Influential Network Relation Map (INRM).
settings.scale_max_help: Highest score on the rating scale (e.g. 4 for a 0–4 scale). Values above it are rejected.
settings.gap_limit_help: Criterion for judging whether expert opinions are stable. The consensus gap is how much (%) the average matrix changes when the last expert is added; a gap below this value means consensus. 5% is the common convention. This is a reference indicator only — the analysis always runs.
settings.anonymize_help: Show files as Expert 1, Expert 2, … in results and exports.
settings.decimals_help: Decimal places shown in tables, the INRM, and the interpretation text. Downloaded CSV/Excel files always keep full precision.
summary.gap_help:
How much (%) the average matrix changed when the last expert was added. Below the consensus threshold (sidebar) means opinions have stabilized.

If it is above the threshold, the results are still valid to compute, but consider recruiting more experts, reviewing responses that differ greatly, or noting this limitation when reporting. The Matrices tab shows the gap at each step.
threshold.method_help:
The threshold θ decides which influence relations are treated as significant. Only relations with tᵢⱼ ≥ θ are drawn as INRM arrows, highlighted in matrix T, and counted in the interpretation.

- **Mean of T**: the most common default.
- **Mean + standard deviation**: stricter; use it when the map has too many arrows.
- **Custom**: set θ yourself with a slider.
threshold.value_help: The slider ranges from the smallest to the largest off-diagonal value of T. Raising θ shows fewer, stronger relations.
threshold.theta_help: Threshold currently applied. The line below shows how many of the n(n−1) possible relations between different factors are at or above θ.
settings.guide:
**Scale maximum** (default 4)  
Highest score of your rating scale: 3 for 0–3, 5 for 0–5. Values above it are rejected as errors.

**Decimal places** (default 3)  
Display precision of tables, the INRM, and the interpretation. Downloads keep full precision.

**Consensus threshold** (default 5%)  
If the consensus gap is below this value, expert opinions are judged to have reached consensus. Reference only; the analysis always runs.

**Anonymize expert names** (default off)  
Shows Expert 1, Expert 2, … instead of file names in results and downloads.

**Threshold method** (default: mean of T)  
Decides which relations are significant (INRM arrows, highlighted cells, interpretation). *Mean + SD* is stricter; *Custom* lets you set θ with a slider.
input.uploader: Upload one CSV file per expert (multiple files allowed)
input.uploader_help: First row and first column contain factor names; the rest is an n × n matrix. UTF-8 and CP949 encodings are supported.
input.guide:
**Just three rules:**
1. **One CSV file per expert.**
2. Write the factor names in the **first row and first column**, in the same order.
3. In the other cells, score how much the **row factor influences the column factor**, from 0 (none) to {max} (very high). The diagonal is 0.
input.empty: No data yet? Click **Load sample data** to try the app right away with built-in data from 3 experts.
input.example_caption: Example: the highlighted 4 (row F2, column F3) means F2 has an influence of 4 on F3. Create the table in Excel and save it as "CSV UTF-8".
input.sample_active: Analyzing the built-in **sample data** (3 experts × 5 factors). Upload your own files to replace it.
validate.has_errors: The input has errors. Fix the files below and upload them again.
validate.has_warnings: The analysis continued with the following adjustments:
issue.decode_failed: Cannot read the file. Save it as CSV in UTF-8 or CP949 encoding.
issue.not_square: The matrix is not square: {rows} rows × {cols} columns (excluding factor names).
issue.empty_name: Factor name at position {pos} is empty.
issue.duplicate_name: Factor name "{name}" appears more than once.
issue.name_mismatch: Row and column factor names differ at position {pos}: "{row}" vs "{col}".
issue.out_of_range: Value {value} at row {row}, column {col} is outside 0 – {max}.
issue.diagonal_nonzero: Diagonal value of {factor} was {value}; replaced with 0.
issue.non_integer: {count} non-integer value(s) found; used as is.
issue.factor_mismatch: Factor names or order differ from {ref}.
error.all_zero: All values are 0, so the matrix cannot be normalized.
error.singular: The total-relation matrix cannot be computed because (I − X) is singular. This happens when every factor has the same row sum (or the same column sum); check the input values.
summary.s_help: Normalization factor = the larger of the largest row sum and the largest column sum of the average matrix A. Dividing A by s keeps all row and column sums ≤ 1, so the total-relation matrix T can be computed.
ind.caption: R: total influence a factor gives · C: total influence it receives · R+C: importance in the system · R−C > 0: cause, < 0: effect · Rank is by weight. Click a column header to sort.
map.hint: Arrows show relations with tᵢⱼ ≥ θ (thicker = stronger). Hover over a point or arrow midpoint for values. Use the camera icon in the chart toolbar to download the image.
quad.meaning1: Core cause factors — top management priority
quad.meaning2: Independent cause factors — some influence on other factors
quad.meaning3: Independent effect factors — relatively low importance
quad.meaning4: Core effect factors — managed indirectly by improving cause factors
interp.top_prominence: Factors with the highest prominence (R+C) are {items}; they are the most involved in the system.
interp.cause: Cause group (R−C > 0): {items}. These factors drive the others.
interp.effect: Effect group (R−C < 0): {items}. These factors are mainly influenced by others.
interp.no_cause: No factor belongs to the cause group.
interp.no_effect: No factor belongs to the effect group.
interp.strongest: The strongest cause is **{cause}** (R−C = {cause_value}) and the strongest effect is **{effect}** (R−C = {effect_value}).
interp.relations: {count} relation(s) exceed the threshold θ = {theta}. Strongest: {items}.
interp.no_relations: No relation exceeds the threshold θ = {theta}. Try a lower threshold.
mat.T_caption: T = X(I − X)⁻¹. Highlighted cells: tᵢⱼ ≥ θ = {theta} (diagonal excluded).
mat.gap_caption: Average gap ratio between the mean of p−1 and p experts (cells with a zero mean are excluded). Consensus when below {limit}%. Experts are added in upload order.
exp.hint: CSV files are UTF-8 with BOM so they open correctly in Excel. To save the INRM as an image, use the camera icon on the INRM tab.
exp.excel_hint: One sheet each for expert inputs, A, X, T, indicators, and settings.
ai.not_configured: The AI writing feature is not configured on this server (LLM_API_KEY and LLM_MODEL are missing in .env).
ai.context_placeholder: e.g. Key factors for digital transformation in Taiwanese SMEs
ai.context_help: A short description of your research topic. It is used only to name the topic; all numbers come from the analysis.
ai.error: The AI draft could not be generated. Try again later. ({detail})
ai.review_notice: Numbers are filled in automatically from the analysis. Review the wording and interpretation before using it in a paper.
ai.description.results: Writes the results section of a paper from the analysis above.
ai.description.indicators: Writes a caption, a symbol note, and a descriptive paragraph for the indicator table.
ai.description.inrm: Writes a caption and a descriptive paragraph for the INRM figure.
ai.description.procedure: Writes a methods paragraph describing how the analysis was carried out on this data (experts, normalization, total-relation matrix, consensus, threshold).
ai.verified: ✓ Number check passed: all {numbers} numbers were inserted from the Python calculation (the AI wrote no numbers itself). LLM calls: {attempts}
ai.blocked: The AI kept writing numbers itself or using undefined placeholders, so the draft was blocked after {attempts} attempts. Please try again.
ai.blocked_detail: Rule violations in the last attempt
ai.language_help: Defaults to the screen language. Choose another language to write the paper text in it; changing the screen language resets this to the new screen language.
ai.beta_free: AI features are free during the beta period.
